summary.name: Oil Painting / Gouache (supplemental; choose one medium).
summary.visualIdentity: Visible brushwork and opaque color masses. Oil allows varied thickness and impasto; gouache favors matte, opaque masses. Choose one primary medium per project. Provenance is supplemental.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: painted scenes and layered scenery. Inferred: painted intros, landscape stories, and gouache event posters with one loop. Fit for a specific subject is unverified.
summary.limitations: Keep standalone for painted scenes. Avoid mixing impasto and matte gouache, generic filters, fake brush jitter, glossy effects, and excess parallax. Source review covered only sampled seconds 1–8.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent. Tokens #F1E6CF, #3E4C48, #9B604C, #A89656, #63818A are illustrative, not approved; task colors override them. Foreground on background is 7.272:1; accents are decorative only. Gradients are disabled.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Seekable repainting, brush reveals, and layered-scenery motion with one owner per property. Optional motion-012 (chaptered handoff) and motion-015 (narrative steps) apply only if the scene supports them. Scroll and hover are interactive-only.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style. Task-specific suggestions may include music, voiceover, effects, ambience, or silence, with no fixed genre or required layer. No audio was supplied or verified; speech must stay intelligible.
summary.assetRequirements: Optional: layered paint assets with alpha, numbered frames, or a layer manifest, plus coverage masks and local fonts. Inspect transparency, dimensions, and naming first. No upload is mandatory; source review is evidence, not reusable artwork.
summary.combinations: style-101 for layered paint planes with shared lighting and one medium. style-103 for a held gouache poster with one loop focal point. Avoid glossy effects and busy loops. Compatibility is suggested, not verified.
summary.productionApproach: Renderer: prepared paint layers and coverage masks, composited for local repainting, with Pillow preprocessing. Motion: one owner per property via GSAP or native Canvas/SVG. HyperFrames handles assembly, check, snapshot, and render; Remotion only on a recorded limitation.
